'''Rakesh the Foul''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. A wanted criminal, he was locked up by the [[Dust Vipers]] gang on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] after he tried to chew off their leader [[Bel Nerodia]]'s hand. In [[3630 BBY]] the [[Eternal Alliance]] ambushed the Dust Viper compound, looking to reclaim the stolen security codes of the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]]. On the suggestion of [[Hylo Visz]] they made a detour and defeated Rakesh, ridding the galaxy of him.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rakesh appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as an optional boss during the "Done and Dusted" Uprising.
